# Phynd Crm Full LLM Context

Generated: 2026-05-28

## Purpose

This file gives LLM agents a stable, tool-agnostic map for working in this
repository without depending on vendor-specific instruction files.

## Canonical instruction order

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `README.md` if present
3. `ECOSYSTEM.md` if present
4. Relevant files under `docs/`, `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`, and source
   directories for the specific task
5. `docs/CODEBASE_AND_PROD_EVIDENCE_2026-05-27.md` for the latest verified
   codebase/prod-status snapshot when documentation or production state matters
6. `docs/ROADMAP.md` and `docs/MADFAM_TRUTH_LAYER_REMEDIATION.md` for phased
   targets, gap scorecard, and workstream acceptance criteria

## Agent compatibility

`AGENTS.md` is the source of truth. `CLAUDE.md` exists only to redirect Claude
and other legacy agent integrations to `AGENTS.md`.

## Enclii-first operations contract

Use Enclii web, API, or CLI for routine production provisioning, deployment,
observability, domain management, secrets, provider operations, scaling,
rollback, and remediation.

Raw `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs/APIs, `docker exec`, and direct
container access are allowed only for platform bootstrap or documented
break-glass emergencies when Enclii is unavailable or lacks an implemented
adapter. Any break-glass use must record the actor, reason, target
service/environment, commands executed, result, and follow-up Enclii adapter
gap or incident link.

## Identity contract (2026-09-30)

- The acting user id (`session.user.id` → `AuthContext.userId`) is the Janua OIDC
  `sub`, set in the Auth.js `jwt` callback at sign-in. Auth.js v5's own
  `token.sub` is a random UUID per sign-in (JWT sessions, no adapter) and must not
  be used as an id.
- Service and system actors keep fixed ids: `service:selva`, `system`,
  `service:email-drip`, `dev-user` (dev only), `demo-{sessionId}`.
- CRM `users.id` is separate; `users.external_janua_id` (unique) links it to a
  Janua subject. FK owner columns reference `users.id`.
- Resolution (2026-10-01): each request resolves `januaSub` → `crmUserId`
  (`users.id` or null) once, cached 30 s. Signing in never creates a CRM user.
- FK writes and per-user reads (`listMine`, notifications, `activities.create`,
  `contacts.bulkCreate`) use `crmUserId`. Unlinked → tRPC `PRECONDITION_FAILED`,
  `data.appCode = 'CRM_USER_NOT_LINKED'`, Spanish message for the UI.
  Service/system/demo principals keep their fixed ids.
- Free-text actor columns store the CRM user id when linked, else the Janua
  `sub` (`actorIdOf`). Referral `*_janua_id` columns keep the Janua `sub`.
- Admins link/unlink in Settings → Users (`users.linkJanua` / `unlinkJanua`,
  audited, conflicts → `CONFLICT`). Backfill: `scripts/link-janua-users.mjs`
  (dry-run default, `--apply`). Read-only audit:
  `scripts/audit-session-user-ids.mjs`. Details: `docs/IDENTITY.md`.
- Operator order (dry-run first): run the read-only audit; run
  `link-janua-users.mjs` with no flags to list unlinked users, then with
  `--links <file>` to validate a `{ "<users.id>": "<janua sub>" }` mapping;
  add `--apply` only when every link is valid (exit 3 = refused, nothing
  written). Both print counts and short ids only. `--database-env` selects a
  per-tenant DB. Commands: README § Identity and access.
- Tests: `apps/web/src/lib/auth/__tests__/janua-sign-in.test.ts` (Auth.js flow
  against a stub Janua), `apps/web/src/lib/trpc/__tests__/crm-user-resolution.test.ts`,
  `packages/api/src/__tests__/crm-user-link.router.test.ts`, and
  `scripts/__tests__/` (run by `pnpm test:pp5` in the CI Unit Tests job).
- Janua token contract (issuer, JWKS, audience): Janua's
  `docs/guides/ECOSYSTEM_INTEGRATION.md` § Token Validation.

## Pilot ops scripts (2026-05-29)

| Script | When |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm verify:pilot-go-live` | Pre-flight before any tier deploy (static checks only) |
| `pnpm verify:post-deploy` | After ArgoCD sync — live `/api/health` (+ optional auth/Selva probes) |
| `pnpm db:migrate:tier` | Artifact check (`--check-only`) or apply migrations with `DATABASE_URL` |
| `pnpm verify:selva-agent` | After `FEDERATION_API_TOKEN` is set on target tier |

Promotion/rollback workflows (`promote-to-prod.yml`, `rollback-prod.yml`) call
`scripts/verify-post-deploy.mjs` with 6×20s retries instead of raw `curl`.

Runbook: `docs/runbooks/PILOT_GO_LIVE.md`

## Maintenance

These files are maintained by `internal-devops/scripts/sync-agent-docs.py`.
If repo-specific long-form agent guidance is needed, put it in `AGENTS.md`,
not `CLAUDE.md`.
